tree.heading: Board of Directors.—
tree.text: The composition of the board of directors of the corporation, and the responsibilities of the board, are as provided in the articles of incorporation of the corporation.

tree.heading: Officers.—
tree.text: The positions of officers of the corporation, and the election of the officers, are as provided in the articles of incorporation.
